summary_1line: Rukmi offers arrogant aid to both Pandavas and Kauravas but is rejected, after which Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya about events before the battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Armored Rukmi arrives at the Pandava camp beneath a sun-bright banner, surrounded by an Akshauhini of troops and the thunderous bow Vijaya in hand.
Arjuna, smiling calmly among gathered kings, refuses Rukmi's boastful offer while holding the radiant Gandiva bow.
The blind king Dhritarashtra sits in his palace speaking anxiously to Sanjaya, confessing that fate and his son’s stubbornness drive the kingdom toward ruin.
